😮What if I told you we found a brewery inside a 300-year-old former convent/monastery complex in Vienna? 🍺🇦🇹 Just a short walk from Belvedere Palace, salmbraeu.vienna sits within the historic Salesian convent complex dating back to 1717 — and one of its dining halls was even once used as a stable for the Empress’s carriage horses.
